title: nf-austin/echidna samplesheet
description: One row per sample: an scRNA-seq .h5ad and, optionally, a bulk WGS segmentation file.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and must not contain spaces
sample.description: Sample identifier. Becomes the output subdirectory name, so it must be unique.

h5ad.errorMessage: h5ad path must be provided, must not contain spaces, and must end in .h5ad
h5ad.description: Path to the annotated AnnData .h5ad. For a multi-timepoint run this is the pre-concatenated object.

seg_txt.errorMessage: seg_txt path must not contain spaces
seg_txt.description: Optional bulk WGS segmentation file. Leave blank to run this sample in no-WGS mode.
